name: k3s-azure
description: Operate a small-team k3s cluster on Azure: investigate an incident from symptom to the commit that caused it, run Terraform safely against a cost ceiling, reach the cluster without a tunnel, and keep observability inside a daily ingestion cap. Distilled from a real Phase 1 delivery.

AZURE_CONFIG_DIR.title: Azure CLI config directory
AZURE_CONFIG_DIR.description: Config directory for THIS client's subscription. Leave blank for the default ~/.azure. Set it when the machine holds more than one Azure account — a bare `az` silently targets whichever was logged in last.

RESOURCE_GROUP.title: Resource group
RESOURCE_GROUP.description: Resource group holding the cluster, e.g. rg-acme-prod.

ARC_CLUSTER.title: Arc connected-cluster name
ARC_CLUSTER.description: Used to reach kubectl without opening the Kubernetes API port. Blank if the cluster is not Arc-connected.

APP_NAMESPACE.title: Application namespace
APP_NAMESPACE.description: Kubernetes namespace the application runs in.

LOG_WORKSPACE.title: Log Analytics workspace
LOG_WORKSPACE.description: Workspace that receives cluster telemetry. Without it an investigation can only read logs from pods that are still alive.

IMAGE_REPOS.title: Deployment to git repository map
IMAGE_REPOS.description: Comma-separated deployment=repo-path pairs, e.g. api=/c/dev/acme-api,web=/c/dev/acme-web. This is what lets an investigation walk from a running image tag to the commit that produced it.

MONTHLY_CEILING_USD.title: Monthly cost ceiling (USD)
MONTHLY_CEILING_USD.description: Hard ceiling for this subscription. Used to refuse changes that would breach it.
